### New Weapons & Backpack Blueprints at **Gilman Lumber Mill (Responders)**

- **Blueprint: Weapon Paint (Rust)**
Includes paint jobs for: 10mm Pistol, Western Revolver, Battle Rifle, Baseball Bat, Pump Action Shotgun
- **Plan: Weapon paint (gunmetal)**
Includes paint jobs for: 10mm Pistol, Western Revolver, Battle Rifle, Baseball Bat, Pump Action Shotgun
- **Blueprint: Weapon Paint (Vault-Tec)**
Includes paint jobs for: 10mm Pistol, Western Revolver, Battle Rifle, Baseball Bat, Pump Action Shotgun
- **Blueprint: Vault-Tec Survival Backpack**
Also included in the level 20 loadouts for new players
